gates.summary: Every material item in all seven locked reference snapshots has a disposition.
Canonical normative claims have primary evidence, qualifications, versions, counterexamples, and owners.

The 109-case canonical corpus, four-client adapters, and current archives pass structural checks; archives reproduce byte-identically from source commit fdfd794, and an earlier milestone has clean-clone Codex installation evidence.
A private release holdout with unrelated prompts has not been frozen and scored.
All collection and combined discovery footprints are within the conservative serialized limits.

Zero critical failures is not established across the full quality and holdout matrix. Ours strictly passed zero repetitions in both settlement families, scored 12/13 in the only completed corrected runtime-reload repetition, and the fifteen newest scenarios have no treatment evidence.
Post-edit oracle isolation works, but six smokes—including three behavior-rich multi-file cases—saturated across every native arm; discriminatory fixture evidence is not established.

Public routing clears paired thresholds. Ours leads the final batch-offset and both settlement families in aggregate, but the completed corrected runtime-reload repetition was won 13/13 by golang-ddd-skills and the campaign was intentionally stopped. Aggregate behavioral superiority and confidence bounds remain unestablished.

Collection-level non-inferiority is not established. Fintech has a strong manifest-close transfer lead but zero strict settlement passes; Distributed Systems includes the lease/fencing baseline tie; Engineering includes a saturated compatibility case and one corrected runtime-reload loss to golang-ddd-skills.

Ours beat baseline in all three manifest-close repetitions and narrowly led settlement correction, but tied baseline 12/13 in the completed corrected runtime-reload repetition and Distributed Systems includes ties. No statistically positive cross-scenario paired behavioral improvement is established.

Ours quality-and-token dominates every skill competitor on manifest-close and four on settlement correction. However cxuu-golang-skills dominated authorization, the client-compatibility case saturated while ours used more input than all but Gophers, and baseline remains much cheaper across hard transfers. The global behavioral frontier is not established.

Development artifacts, including the intentionally incomplete runtime-reload series and current package provenance, are traceable; the complete release-candidate and private-holdout artifacts do not yet exist.
